specification_compliance: Checked only as far as the listed findings reach. Stat-error handling in the migration, I12's stat-failure case and the touch-point list each depart from the approved spec as those findings state, and invariants.md records no revision.
Spec section 2's new-id cleanup is present at upload.py:363-364, and removal of a ghost's picture after the commit is present at upload.py:366, fileops.py:330 and fileops.py:406.
potential_unspecified_behavior: A stat error other than not-found keeps the pointer and counts as failed (thumbnail_migration.py:31-32, :83-92), and the thumbnail route then answers 500 while the error lasts. No spec section or revision states this, and no ruling is recorded.
A non-regular file at a pointer counts as absent (thumbnail_migration.py:33-34), and the directory stays in the cache. The spec groups by whether the file exists and does not address this.
A stat error on the source's picture fails the whole copy at fileops.py:255. I12 covers a failure copying the picture, and whether it covers this case is for a human to read.

slot.is_file() at thumbnail_migration.py:125 sits outside any OSError handler. If Path.is_file re-raises a permission error, an absent-file row stops the run rather than failing that row alone. The lifespan catches it at main.py:278, and the next startup retries. This was inferred from reading and was not run.
regression_risks: The failure-path tests swallow every exception, so a later change to setup or routing that stops them reaching the ghost's path would leave them green.
Moving the trashed ghost's delete back ahead of the generator would reintroduce the write lock held during generation with no test failing, by reading.
The os.replace warning and three count updates can change with no test failing, though the admin guide tells the operator to read that log line.
test_coverage: test_the_returned_counts_say_what_happened pins one moved kind (a real move) and one failed kind (a stat failure). It does not pin a repoint, an os.replace failure or a failed removal of a shared file.
test_a_picture_that_cannot_be_copied_leaves_copy_and_no_partial_slot covers a copy failure from a directory at the pointer. It does not cover a stat error at fileops.py:255.
No test reads the ordering at upload.py:280-294.
